conversation.text: How much is the maintenance plan?
The Comfort Club has two plans, according to the Comfort Club overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md).
Comfort Club Standard is $189 per year per system, or $16.99 per month, and each additional system at the same address is $99 per year.
Comfort Club Plus is $269 per year per system.
Standard members can upgrade to Plus at any time, and the $80 difference is prorated for the months left in the current term.

Standard includes two seasonal tune-ups a year (one cooling, one heating), priority scheduling, the $89 diagnostic fee waived on service calls, 15% off all repairs, no after-hours dispatch fee on emergency calls, and annual reminder and filter-change notifications.
Plus adds an annual water heater flush and inspection, an annual whole-home plumbing inspection, and 15% off plumbing repairs.
Both plans get $500 off any full system replacement.
Monthly plans require a 12-month minimum commitment.
I thought it was $149?
The $149 figure isn't a membership price.
In the 2026 Repair Price Book (pricing/repair_price_book_2026.csv), $149 is the after-hours dispatch fee, which is waived for Comfort Club members.

The 2026 fee schedule (pricing/2026_fee_schedule.pdf) lists membership at $189 per year for Comfort Club and $269 per year for Comfort Club Plus, with the monthly option at $16.99 for Comfort Club only.
The same schedule lists the seasonal tune-up at $129 for non-members, and it is included twice a year for Comfort Club and Comfort Club Plus members.
Hm. Okay.
Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's it. Thanks.
Thanks for contacting Meridian Home Comfort. Have a great day.

Meridian registers every installed unit with the manufacturer within 30 days of install, and registration is required for the full parts warranty term.

If the unit has water pooling at the indoor unit, turn the system off to prevent overflow damage and book a visit (Before You Call: Quick Checks).
